description: Safety-ranked open-source component discovery for agents across six package ecosystems.
name: io.github.Aniket-kr1030/ossfind

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Raises the GitHub repository-search rate limit; discovery works without it.
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Optional libraries.io key, used as the PyPI discovery fallback when no local index has been built. Without it, and without an index, PyPI search reports itself unavailable rather than returning nothing.
environmentVariables.name: LIBRARY_IO_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run fully offline against frozen supplier responses, for evaluation without network access.
environmentVariables.name: OSSFIND_FIXTURES

title: ossfind
